states.changed: The work is built: the 19 reports an event sets off, each on a door — the sender's clock on one side, what the receiver must, may or is only encouraged to do on the other, with both sides' consequences and every passage behind them.

The second state is added: what the receivers in the two cases of step 6 actually did, 47 acts at 18 doors on two timelines, each drawn by whether a duty, a power or nothing owed it and opening to its passage, with the predictions P161 to P163 and the answer rewritten for the deeds.

The check is added: five blind readers coded everything again (113 of 114 cells the same for the texts; 74 acts instead of 47 for the cases, still 5 owed), every disagreement reconciled with its reason, and a grid of the 20 duties the two cases could set off shows none met; the acts are redrawn with the name held while the days scroll, and the maker's two clocks are shown.
